source_description: 30+ fully functional demo pages demonstrating all implemented modules (B01-B21, F01-F09) with real backend integration. Strategic Product Owner needs visual proof for every module with click-through experience using realistic demo data. Real backend integration (no mocks), consistent F06 templates, Chart.js for visualizations, Playwright E2E tests per page, <2s page load via lazy loading. 24 pages total: Core Foundation (B01-B04) 4 pages, Identity (B05-B08) 6 pages, Configuration (B09-B12) 4 pages, Platform (B13-B18) 6 pages, Frontend showcase (F01-F09) 6 pages minus F08, Docs (B19, B21) 2 pages. Navigation via sidebar grouped by category, React Router v6, protected routes, permission-based access via B08.
